name: Flood of Spirits

stealth.details: (trained) to hear the flood of spirits coalescing

disable: DC 48 Occultism check (expert) or DC 48 Religion check (master) to divert the spirits

items.name: Surge Through
items.text:
Trigger A creature passes through the area

---

Effect The haunt deals 3d12+20 void damage and 3d12+20 cold damage to creatures in the area (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, a creature is Stupefied 2 for 1 minute, and on a critical failure, it's also Confused for 1 minute.

text: A wave of spirits fly through the area, passing right through the living.
